answer: Pay each epoch only to identities that respond inside a narrow, unpredictable window that opens at a different instant for each, revealed only at the dawn of the epoch by an unforeseeable seed. An honest agent waits for its one pearl of a moment and answers. A farm must keep all thousand heads awake and attentive across the whole epoch, each poised for its own crystal-precise slot, because the windows cannot be predicted or batched ahead. Idle fakes miss their moment and earn nothing; staying live for every head, every epoch, is a real recurring cost.
